balls.text: Moeen steps out to Maxwell this time. Another round-arm dart, but this is shorter from Maxwell. Worked away only as far as short fine leg
darted full and wide of off stump, heaved away to long-on off the inner half
Jadeja steps out to Maxwell once again, this time he holes out to long-on. Jadeja doesn't get close enough to the pitch, and finds Prabhudessai, who is subbing for Faf
short and darted down the leg side, left alone, another wide
Jadeja dashes out of the crease and pumps Maxwell high and long over the long-on boundary. Pushed through from round the stumps, Jadeja uses his feet and goes big

Harshal keeps searching for the yorker outside off. Another high-full toss outside off, not called a beamer this time. CSK challenge the on-field call now. Stabbed away off the inside half to the right of DK. Above the waistline. No-ball called. Free-hit coming up
full and veering down the leg side, another on-pace delivery, wide called
dipper on the leg stump, 121.4ks, Jadeja can't get it away off the bat. The ball brushes the pad and rolls away to short fine leg
beamer outside off, well above the waistline, flapped away into the leg side. No-ball called. RCB challenge the on-field call. It's clearly a no-ball. Free-hit coming up
Jadeja gives Harshal the charge. Meets a wide yorker early and splices the full-toss down to long-off
very full and very wide of off, Jadeja reaches out for the ball and carves it away off a thick outside edge to deep third. Excellent over from Siraj
attempts a wide yorker, comes out as a low full-toss outside off, chopped away to deep third
fullish and on the stumps, another on-pace delivery, which is hoicked away to deep square
back of a length and running away outside off, 143ks, Jadeja can't touch it. Not a wide
yorker outside off, Moeen jams his bat down hastily and picks up a single to mid-off
shortish and into the hips, Moeen picks it up and swats it over long leg for six more. Can't bowl there to Moeen. Got to get it up higher

Hasaranga almost pulls off a stunning catch. Wide yorker from Vyshak, Moeen slices it flat and fairly low to backward point. The ball bursts out of Hasaranga's right hand. It didn't stick. 200 up for CSK
on a length and wide of off, 120.3ks, slashed away to deep point

DK calls for it and settles underneath this skier. Top-edged behind to the keeper. Another slower ball into the pitch. Possibly another legcutter. Rayudu, having jumped across off, slogs to the leg side and ends up flapping it behind to the keeper
slower ball, short and wide of off, chopped away to backward point. Decent save from the infielder
pumped over long-on for six. Slot ball on off as Vyshak misses his on-pace yorker. Rayudu gets underneath the length and clears the straight boundary
Vyshak hits a hard length with a slower ball and hides it away from Rayudu's reach. He throws his bat at ball and splices this legcutter over DK's head

launches it straight. Length ball. On pace. That's bread and butter here at this ground. Moeen has the chance to free the arms, because again, he is batting on leg stump and the ball is outside off. Full swing of the bat. Ball goes bye-bye
full on middle and off, Rayudu, who is a good batter on the off side, stays leg side of the ball so he can access that part of the ground better and drives to deep point
works a good length ball on off stump away to deep square leg

taken deep deep midwicket, inches from the rope. The on-pace ball really travels here in the Chinnaswamy. Even though it comes off close to the bottom of the bat, because Parnell bowled full and at the pads, Dube gets the ball to travel long. Siraj is on the boundary. He's so cool too. He knows he's in the game. He knows if he stays calm he has a superb catch. And that's what happens.
takes the pace off, but importantly, he digs it into the wicket, just back of a length. Dube set up to slog again, mis-hits and gets an inside edge to the keeper

straight down the ground, straight out of the ground. Twenty-five ball fifty for Dube and this time he's been given a gift. Parnell allows him all the room he wants to free the arms. Slot ball wide outside off. Smashed
lifts the full toss on middle down the ground to long-on
full toss now, but this one dips too, making Rayudu play along the ground to deep point

dipping yorker. Harshal has been trying for this all night. And he's been getting closer and closer. Now he nails it. The ball starts out almost lobbing above the batter's eyeline, making him wind up for the big shot. But then 3/4th of the way down the pitch, it dips sharply. Conway isn't ready for it. He loses his shape. He's crouching, now trying just to get bat on it, instead of the six he was looking for. No dice. Beautiful stuff from Harshal. Bravo used to get this dip. This dip is the reason he was so hard to it and its the reason why Harshal is soo good at the death
off-stump yorker, swings in, squeezed through midwicket
banged in short and angling across off stump. Third man is in. Dube leans back and ramps it over short third for four more
full-toss on the hips, Harshal gets away with that, spliced wide of square leg
wide yorker from Vyshak. It's a decent ball, but Conway makes it look a whole lot worse by slicing it away fine of deep third for four more
Conway launches this slower ball over the shorter leg-side boundary. Slower one into the pitch, Conway delays the pull and swats it over the leg side
short and into the pitch, the line is outside off, dragged away along the ground to wide long-on
Vyshak misses the yorker. On-pace full-toss outside off, Dube lays into Vyshak and mows it over the wide long-on boundary
hip-high short ball outside off, knuckle ball? Into the pitch. Hauled away to deep midwicket
good ball. Low full-toss wide of off, sliced away to deep point
Siraj pounds it on a heavy length and on the stumps, keeps Dube down to a single to long-off
Siraj bangs it short and outside off, but the boundaries here are smaller. Dube hooks this slower bouncer over square leg for six
full and wide of off, almost a yorker, inside the tramline. Dube lets it go
on-pace short ball dug into the pitch, Dube hauls a pull wide of mid-on
pumped over mid-off for four more. Slower ball offcutter from Siraj. On a length and outside off, Dube manufactures swinging room and smashes it over mid-off
short and wide of off, past the tramline, off-side wide
just short of a good length and on off, hauled away to mid-on
another wide yorker from Harshal, well executed once again. Conway reaches out for the ball and loses his balance in the process
Harshal nails the wide yorker, plinked down to long-off. Just a single
on-pace full ball outside off, just short of a yorker length, Dube can't touch it
shorter and at the body, better length to Dube, worked away to deep square leg
Clubbed over long-on for another huge six. Harshal aims for a slower yorker once again, but this comes out as a full-toss on the stumps, Dube muscles it away
slower dipper outside off, that's a Harshal special. Plunges on Dube who drives and misses
Conway picks it up and dumps Vyshak over the fine-leg boundary. Goes full once again, probably too straight, Conway brings his wrists into play and these boundaries aren't big enough
good ball from Vyshak. Back of a length, angling in and straightens away late past the outside edge
short and into the body, that's Dube's weakness. He hangs back and flaps a single into the square-leg region
short and into the body, Conway rolls his wrists and pulls it away to the right of long leg
Yes, CSK will attack the RCB rookie. Full and wide of off, slower ball from Vyshak. Conway still reaches out and scythes it up and over backward point
shortish and outside off, Conway waits for the ball to come onto him, he opens the bat face and guides it away between short third and backward point
Conway stretches out and reverse-sweeps it away for a single
whisked away down the ground for a single
Dube hits the roof of the Chinnaswamy Stadium. Pushed through on middle, Dube doesn't move his feet much, extends his hands and pumps it high over Maxwell's head for a monster six
flat and quick outside off, Conway's turn to punch a single down to long-on
short and into the pitch, no room for Dube to free his arms, forced down to long-on this time
short and sliding in from round the stumps, forced back to Maxwell
another wrong'un, short and keeps low outside off, Conway has a crack at it and under-edges it past the stumps for four more
another wrong'un, this is short and to the left-hander. Conway rocks back and swats it away between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Back-to-back half-centuries for Conway
pushed through flat and quick on middle, driven down to long-on as Dube gets off the mark

Hasaranga gives RCB the breakthrough. Hasaranga lobs up a wrong'un and gets it to break in towards off stump. Rahane swings for the hills but loses his shape this time and does not connect with the ball. Hasaranga hits off stump
dragged down on middle, right in the slot for the pull, but this hauled away along the ground to deep midwicket
Smoked over midwicket. Dropped short on off or just a shade outside off, Conway rocks back and pummels a pull over the leg side

Rahane picks it away past short fine leg for four more. On a back of a length and largely holds its line outside off, Rahane knows fine leg is inside the circle, so he manipulates it past him and moves to 37 off 19 balls
back of a length and outside off, punched down the ground for a single
short of a length and outside off, another on-pace delivery from Harshal, Conway cuts and finds backward point
slower ball from Harshal. Pitched-up delivery outside off, 124ks, Conway adjusts and chips his drive over short cover
swatted away over midwicket for six. Hip-high short ball outside off, on-pace delivery from Harshal. Conway picks it up and puts Harshal over the leg-side boundary
on-pace back of a length ball sliding down the leg side. Conway swings hard but can't quite meet the ball. Leg-side wide
full and slow outside off, Conway delays  the drive and pushes it back to the right of Harshal
whisked away through midwicket from a middle-stump line. Conway and Rahane hare across for the second
paddle-swept from the stumps. Conway gets it fine of short fine leg
fired into middle and leg, forced down to long-on off the back foot
on a length and breaking down the leg side, Conway sinks to one knee and paddle-sweeps it to short fine leg
dragged down on leg stump, not sure if this was a wrong'un, Rahane hauls a pull to deep midwicket
Conway steps out once again. Hasaranga shortens his length, attacks the stumps, and keeps Conway to a single to midwicket
short and sliding into the stumps, punched down the ground to long-on
on a length and outside off, Conway plants his front foot and launches it in the air. He lifts it straight of wide long-on for six
too full for the sweep. Conway still goes for a slog-sweep and manages an inside edge onto the front pad
Conway uses his feet, Maxwell fires another one in from round the wicket and hits the pad, but this seems to be heading down leg
darted into the top of the stumps, Rahane goes back and shovels it to wide long-on with the bottom wrist
lobbed up outside off, eased through the covers on the front foot
four more for Rahane. A bit too full on middle and leg, Rahane twirls his wrists and flicks it away in the leg-side gap. The ball rolls into the midwicket boundary. Make that 15 runs off the over
poor ball from Parnell and Rahane puts it away. Very full and sliding down the leg side, with fine leg inside the circle, Rahane picks it up and helps it over short fine leg for six more
Rahane gives Parnell the charge. The bowler cranks it up to 146ks and hits the bat as opposed to bat hitting ball. Spliced into the covers
full and on the stumps, whipped away firmly but straight to the man at midwicket
laced through extra-cover. On a length and on leg and middle, Rahane manufactures swinging room for himself and lashes it away through the off side
veering into the pads, glanced away more or less straight to Vyshak at short fine leg. Conway races across for a single
low full-toss on off, possibly another slower one, draws an inside edge into the leg side. Good finish to the over from Vyshak
slower ball on a short of a length and outside off. Conway is early into a pull and therefore misses it
short and wide of off stump, cracked away to deep point on the back foot
Whoa!Rahane launches a hook and pings the roof of the Chinnaswamy Stadium. Hip-high short ball angling into the body, the line is on the stumps, Rahane gets into position swiftly and puts it away
just short of a yorker length on off stump, clipped away to deep square leg

Conway rolls out another scoop and gets it past the right of the keeper. Slightly short and holds its line outside off, he shuffles across the stumps, gets inside the line and lifts it in the air to the right of DK
Rahane goes over mid-on once again. The ball plugs in the deep. Another double for Rahane. On a length and outside off, Rahane clears mid-on
on a fuller side of a good length and leaves Rahane outside off. He has a flat-footed swish at it and misses
Rahane goes over the top and clears wide mid-on. On a length and outside off, Rahane drags it in the air and collects two runs
picked up in the air but does not carry to deep square leg. Back of a length and angling in at off stump from left-arm over the wicket
back of a length and outside off, Conway reaches out for the ball with his hands and chops an inside edge past off stump to DK
full inswinger, finishes on the pads, picked away along the ground to deep square leg
on a length and outside off, Rahane twirls his wrists and picks up a single to mid-on
Conway allows this shortish ball to come to him outside off, and then dinks it down to deep third
just short of a good length and holds its line outside off, Rahane stands tall and punches it between cover and mid-off
shorter and on top of off stump, Rahane camps back and plays it back to Siraj

Siraj strikes in the powerplay once again and roars. Parnell plays a part in the dismissal, completing a sliding catch to his left at long leg. Fullish and veering into the pads, Gaikwad picks it up but can't clear Parnell in the outfield. Chinnaswamy roars with Siraj and Parnell
shorter and ducks back in at the top of off, Gaikwad stands up tall and forces the ball to extra-cover
Scooped over the fine-leg boundary for six. Parnell goes back of a length and on the stumps, but Conway shuffles across and lifts it over the fine-leg fence
on a length and leaves Gaikwad just a shade outside off, 135ks, he eyes up the leg side and ends up chipping a leading edge wide of cover
shorter and largely holds its line outside off. Conway swivels on the back foot and controls a pull out to deep midwicket
another inswinger, this time to Conway, but this is too full and straight. Conway brings his wrists into play and whips it away through midwicket
short and attached with width outside off but Parnell has protection at deep point. Cut away on the back foot for a single
nice and full, Parnell brings this back in against the angle, this inswinger is stabbed back to Parnell
back of a length and angling across off stump, jabbed into the covers by Conway
on the fuller side of a good length once again, the line is outside off, push-driven up to mid-off once again
Conway dashes out of the crease, Siraj smartly drags his length back and gets it to zip past his inside edge. Conway swishes and misses
fullish and outside off, a crease-bound Conway pushes it to mid-off
inswing for Siraj but he strays onto the pads of Conway, who does not nail the flick. Chips it away through the square-leg region
just short of a good length and nipping into middle and leg, Gaikwad taps a single to mid-on and gets off the mark

Jadeja takes it at deep midwicket, cheers go up in the Chinnaswamy and CSK win by eight runs! Was short and wide, Prabhudessai went across and top edged a pull. Ballooned high and Jadeja took an easy catch
Pathirana has all but done it! Prabhudessai goes across and swipes at it, gets it on the pull and gets it to long-on
Nails the yorker, gets it back to the bowler. That's all he can do. Chants of RCB are loud but the CSK support is good too. The visitors are in front
Prabhudessai finally gets the reverse scoop right. Was a wide and full ball, went across and swiped across and it went up and behind like a saucer. Over the keeper for six

Hasaranga is foxed by the slower one. He had his front leg way out down leg, went across and tried to slap it across but had to check his shot. Couldn't stop the ball from coming in and taking the bat. Goes to point
Wide and full, slashed to long-off. Prabhudessai looks for two but it's not on. Sent back
Full outside off, driven to cover
They look to steal two and make it. Was a full ball that was wide. Prabhudessai premeditated, went across and on knee, tried to sweep it. Bunted it, it went off the bottom to the mid-on area
Latches onto the shortish slow ball outside off with a pull. It goes flat between deep midwicket and long-on, lands just over the ropes. 22 needed off 8 now
Tries the reverse scoopy sweep this time. Misses again, the bowler went fuller and wider. Almost went past the return crease. Misses. Wide given
Prabhudessai changes his grip and tries to reverse pull the shortish slower ball outside off. Tries to go over third, misses
Wide and full, toe edge of the cover drive takes it to wide deep third
Slogged in the air, finds long-on! Was a full ball on leg, Parnell tried whipping it across but couldn't clear Dube.
Make that 30 as the full ball slips out too wide. Left alone

Mix up, Moeen doesn't realise the batters were stranded and doesn't throw the ball for a while. He does but is late. Dhoni flicks it back onto the stumps but the batter's back in. Dhoni's got the 'if looks could kill' vibes. Was a full ball outside off driven to cover. Parnell made a complete run and that was when the non-striker started his run.
Wide and full, driven to deep cover
Goes wide, it's too wide outside off. The slower one is taken on the bounce to the right after tumbling across by Dhoni. Left alone, no bye attempted.
Slower bouncer outside off, pulled into the practice pitches. Long-on goes to the left and stops it
Slower one into the pitch foxes Parnell, he tries to drive it through cover. Has to check the shot, ends up missing it
Full outside off, beaten on the cover drive

Shahbaz slashes, it's in the air and Gaikwad takes it this time at long-off. Was a full ball outside off. Shahbaz went across and tried to smash it but the bat turned in the hand. Ruturaj took it low, threw the ball in the air. Dhoni has a word with his bowler
Lowish full toss at 141kph, tries to flick it. Gets it onto the pad, deflects away to the other side
Wide and full, outside the tramline. The batter reaches out and tries to slash it. Misses

Slog sweep is in the air, Theekshana's there at deep midwicket and takes it! Was a low full toss, DK went across and tried to launch it again but it went straight to the fielder. Taken around chest-height. Theekshana celebrates.
Slower one is short and outside off, Karthik goes across and pulls it over midwicket. No one in the deep and that's four

Another drop, this time by Ruturaj running across from long-on. DK went across early, tried to slog it across on one knee. Got it off the edge and it went high in the air. Gaikwad got to it, tried to cup his fingers and take it but it popped out.
Full outside off, close to the off-side tramline. The 140kph ball is driven to cover, at the edge of the ring
Full toss around thigh high just outside off. Punished with a pull. Not middled but in the gap at midwicket, races for four
Full ball outside off at 98kph, driven to wide long-off
Full and flat on off at 103kph, pushed to cover
Pulls the back of length ball with the slight spin to deep midwicket along the ground. DK's timing has been good so far
Length outside off, driven to deep cover. The batters push for two, Conway's throw to the bowler is wide and they made it
Flicks the length ball to midwicket
Flicked along the ground, long-on goes across to the right but it picked up pace off the practice pitches and raced away. Was a low full toss on middle
Wide down leg. Full toss slips out, goes well down leg. Beats the fine sweep
Pulls a shortish ball to deep square leg

MS appeals for a stumping, sent upstairs. Was a length ball pitching on off and spinning away. Karthik went for the off drive and missed it. Karthik's foot was back in the crease but was Dhoni's gloves in front of the wickets as he took the ball? Looked like it, in which case that would be a no-ball! The umpire doesn't look for it and RCB do not review.
DK connects with the pull. Gets a flat six over deep square leg. He got inside the line of the shortish ball on top of the stumps, swivelled as he hit it.
Length just outside off, steered to deep point
DK makes room before going back to middle and off. Gets a back-of-length ball just outside off, pulled along the ground to deep-mid
Back-foot drive takes the length ball outside off to deep point

Top edge, another skier and another catch for Dhoni! Both set batters out, CSK back in the game.  Was a length ball at the stumps, Du Plessis went for the slog sweep. Got an edge, went high, just to the left of the leg side of the cut strip. Dhoni came in, waited, reached out a bit and took it
Big spin. Beats Faf and Dhoni, stopped at short fine.
Slow on a length, pulled with the spin over midwicket for a 78-metre six
Works it across off the back foot to wide long-on
Not off the middle but the pull shot connects with the length ball just outside off. Over midwicket for a six

Shahbaz comes down, Moeen sees him and lands it on a back of length. Defended into the pitch and then back towards Dhoni. The keeper comes down and looks to flick the ball with the underarm but misses the stumps.
Goes back to a length ball on off and opens the face to steer it to short third
Pulls a length ball on leg at 101kph to deep square leg

Tries reverse sweeping, it hits the pad and goes to short fine leg. LBW appeal is turned down, Dhoni reviews. Where was it pitching? Was it outside leg? Length ball hit the outside-half of the slanted pad. Top of the pad was down leg. Hawk-Eye shows it to be pitching outside leg. CSK lose a review
Pulls a back of length ball to deep midwicket
Full ball is flicked to deep midwicket

Skier into the stratosphere, Dhoni gets under it and takes it Was a length ball around sixth, went up. Came down in the vacant forward-short-leg area. Dhoni was searching for it as it came down, did well to keep composure and the ball sunk in the gloves. Dhoni has a word with the ump, maybe about the spidercam. Maxwell's brilliant 76 ends, he gives Shahbaz some tips while leaving
Du Plessis makes room, goes to the leg-side tramline and is beaten on the flick by the length ball. Hit on the body and falls in front
Makes room and slaps the length ball to long-off. Doesn't middle it, went on the bounce
Rahane comes in from long-on but can't reach it, gets it on the half-volley
Makes room and is followed by a length ball at 101kph, clipped to midwicket
Fullish ball on middle and leg, pushed towards mid-off
Over the sightscreen Maxwell is hitting them for fun. Made room and pumped it
Full ball is driven to long-off
Slog sweep connects, over midwicket for another six. Was a length ball at 100kph just outside off. Maxwell gets on on knee and slams it

Theekshana drops a caught-and-bowled chance Was on a back of length just outside off. Faf could not make enough room and the cut went straight back towards the bowler. Theekshana got low and tried clasping it but it popped out, he tried to get it on the second attempt in front but couldn't reach it
Low fully on leg is clipped to deep square
Rahane runs across to the right and slides to save three more! Was a full ball that was drilled past the left of the bowler
Pulls it off the bottom of the bat, goes wide of long-on, stopped well
Slower one into the pitch. Just outside the waist, clipped towards midwicket
Monster pull over backward square and that's on the second tier! Bouncer at chest height, Maxwell swivels and deposits it 94 metres far for his sixth six!
Maxwell tries to cut it fine but misses and the bottom hand is off. Back of length ball close to the off-side tramline.
Maxwell's fifty is up with another skill drive, he raises his bat and the crowd is going bananas. It was full outside off, Maxwell scythed it in the air, too fine for deep point to cut off
Surgically places the drive through cover. Was a wide, full ball. Maxwell got on one knee and crashed it, ball went scorching the grass
Yorker on off at 127kph, driven to mid-off for a single.
Pushes a full ball to long-on. Du Plessis raises a 23-ball fifty, raises his bat and gets generous applause.

Brilliant leap by Rahane, throws the ball in. Has he saved five? Yes. He was at long-off, jumped up and fell on his back, had the ball in his hand for a second. Had to push it in mid-air. Managed to do it in time, came in and kept it to just a single. It was a fullish ball, Maxwell got some room to slash it away
Length ball is slapped to deep cover with limited timing. Faf asks for a new bat
Full and given some air outside off, opens the face and drives it to deep point. Pace: 99kph
That's one. Maxwell made lots of room and pulled it over Gaikwad leaping up at long-on. It goes just over for a six
Slow on middle, Maxwell makes room and slaps the 100kph length ball behind point
Double bluff as Pathirana goes full and wide.
Gets the slashing square drive.Gets the length ball outside off to deep point
Wide down leg. Was a yorker that went too far down, Maxwell tried to clip it and misses.
Pathirana overcompensates by going shorter and Maxwell was waiting for it, pulls it powerfully over midwicket for another 77-metre six. The 24th of the match.
Jams out a cover drive to a yorker on off, goes to the right of the diving Moeen Ali at cover. All along the ground for four
Bouncer is ducked under, was at the head
Slow on a length outside off. The 123kph ball goes below what Maxwell expected, he tried to slash it behind point. Missed it
Speared in on a full length close to the off-side tramline. The 102kph ball takes the edge off the slashing bat, goes to short third
Length on middle and leg at 97kph, flicked to deep midwicket
Length on middle, flicked to long-on
Clips the length ball on leg to deep-backward square
Slow outside off on a length, punched to long-off
Length ball is pushed to cover
Low-backlift flick sails over backward square for six more to end a blockbuster powerplay as Raghav puts it. Was a length ball that wash whipped off the hips
Followed again. Full ball is pushed to mid-on

High in the air and it's cleared the long-off boundary to bring up the fifty stand. Du Plessis made ample room before the ball was bowled, got a back-of-length ball around middle. Slapped it for a 77-metre six
Maxwell takes guard outside leg and gets a length ball on off. Punched to cover
Maxwell looks to make room and Theekshana follows him and nails it in the block hole. Jammed back to the bowler
Flat on a length at 99kph, punched back to the bowler
Slashes, thick outside edge takes the 134kph full ball close to the off-side tramline over short third. One bounce, four.
Inside edge off an attempted slash goes into the ground and behind square. Deep fine leg runs in but can't stop the fast-running batters from taking two
Slot ball is whipped over midwicket for four more
He reaches this time, slams it down the ground. It was slow, full and wide. Du Plessis lunges and slashes it like the ball was bowled by a spinner, a 77-metre six

Du Plessis makes room, Akash sees him and hides the full ball outside off. The batter was coming down at an angle, so was going further down leg. He tried to slash it through point but didn't reach it
Length over middle. Jumps more than du Plessis and his bottom hand comes off the flick. Played sans power, rolls towards midwicket
Flicks the length ball to forward square leg
Goes behind square this time. Gets another length ball. This time around middle. It was lofted for a 69-metre six
Clipped on the up, over square midwicket for four more. Was a length ball on leg, du Plessis saw the ball coming in and stepped leg side to pick it up
Stays leg side and belts it over mid-off. Slightly back of length just outside off, du Plessis waited for it, had ample time to slap it with a horizontal bat
Back of length outside off, back-foot square punch to deep-backward point
Clips a length ball just behind square
Maxwell pilots an on drive and gets it over wide long-on. The ball was pushing length, around off. The batter went across, hit it and held his shape
Punches a length ball over off at 131kph to mid-off
Short ball is down leg, Maxwell helps it away with a pull over fine leg. Goes over the short boundary for a 57-metre six
Length on off at 135kph. Comes in a bit and is blocked to midwicket
Comes in from a back of length, beats the flick and hits him between the thighs
Clips it off the pads to deep fine leg

Dolly for Gaikwad at cover point, Deshpande joins among the wickets. Lomror goes. It was a shortish ball outside off. Lomrom made room and charged, tried to crash it over point but got a top edge off the cut.
Back of length on leg, clipped to square leg
Drifts down leg. Lomror tries to clip the length ball. Misses, goes off the pad through fine leg
Length outside off, pushed in front of point

A drop by Dhoni. It went to his right, went higher than he expected. He was on the move, trying to take it just over his head but it went a bit farther. Was a length ball outside off, du Plessis charged and tried to flay it over point. So much action and we're not ten balls into the innings.
Length just outside off. Guided to point

Skier is dropped by Theekshana running back from mid-off! It was a length ball just outside off. Lomror tried to go straight, went off the bottom of the bat. Theekshana went to the left, took a step in front but then panicked. Ball burst through the hand.
Length outside off, guided to point

That's a novelty drag on! Akash is jumping in celebration. Kohli had made ample room and tried to whip the length ball on leg through midwicket. Got an underedge onto the boot. It deflected onto the front leg and then slid off the back boot, and gently rolled onto the stump. What an unusual way to get out on a belter!
Yorker is jammed with the inner-half of the bat to square leg
Down the track, tries to mow it across. Doesn't middle it but it fizzes in the gap through midwicket. Was around a length. Kohli's bat seemed to turn in his hands a bit, but it was facing downwards
Pitched up. Comes in a bit, clipped to the left of square leg. Half-stopped, misfield allows a couple
